description: Parsing and printing Move notation. A case with no printed or error field must parse and print back unchanged. A case with printed must parse and print as that. A case with error must be rejected: offset is the 0-based character offset of the first invalid token, and token is its text.

cases.name: every outer Layer clockwise
cases.input: R L U D F B

cases.name: every outer Layer counterclockwise
cases.input: R' L' U' D' F' B'

cases.name: every outer Layer half Turn
cases.input: R2 L2 U2 D2 F2 B2

cases.name: every middle Layer, every suffix
cases.input: M E S M' E' S' M2 E2 S2

cases.name: every Cube rotation, every suffix
cases.input: x y z x' y' z' x2 y2 z2

cases.name: a mixed sequence
cases.input: R U R' U' M2 y F2 z' S E'

cases.name: only whitespace is an empty sequence
a wide Turn after valid Moves
Rw' wide notation after a Move
a half Turn with a prime
a prime with a half Turn
Moves with no space between them
a non-breaking space is not a separator
the offset counts every whitespace character
only the first invalid token is reported
